generatedFrom: minecraft-skills authoring checklists, intent lookups, claim policies, output requirements, and fact surfaces

recipes.title: Generate or review a datapack function command
when: the request includes execute, scoreboard, summon, data, function, or other command syntax
the request asks whether command syntax changed between versions

steps.action: Resolve the target Java version, datapack coverage, source policy, fact surfaces, and output requirements.
evidence: Resolved Java version and datapack coverage warnings
Datapack output requirements for final answer checks
steps.stopIfMissing: Ask for a target version or state the latest bundled-version assumption before generating commands.

steps.action: Verify pack_format before generating or changing pack.mcmeta.
evidence: Version detail packFormats.data for the target version
Version support entry for datapack
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not infer pack_format from neighboring versions.

steps.action: Search command paths for the target version and compare versions when migration is requested.
evidence: Command path search result for the target version
Command comparison result when the task is a migration
steps.stopIfMissing: If the command path is not found, do not generate that syntax as verified; report the gap or use a verified alternative.

recipes.failureMode: Generated function files can contain plausible commands that are not present in the target version's command tree.

recipes.title: Generate or review datapack JSON with observed vanilla shapes
when: the request writes advancements, loot tables, predicates, tags, recipes, item modifiers, or other datapack JSON
the request asks whether a JSON field shape exists in observed vanilla data
the request migrates datapack JSON between versions

steps.action: Resolve target version coverage and whether the observed datapack schema surface is bundled, cached, downloadable, or missing.
evidence: Resolved Java version and datapack coverage warnings
Datapack schema surface availability for the target version
steps.stopIfMissing: If the required observed surface is missing locally but downloadable, fetch it before using schema-surface claims.

steps.action: Search observed vanilla datapack JSON paths and compare versions when migration is requested.
evidence: Observed vanilla datapack JSON field shape match
Comparison result for changed observed paths when migration is requested
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not call an observed field a complete or normative schema; state the gap when no observed match exists.

steps.action: Verify referenced vanilla data paths if the JSON points at vanilla files, tags, loot tables, predicates, recipes, or functions.
evidence: Target-version vanilla data path search result
Path comparison result when migrating
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not invent vanilla data paths from naming convention.

recipes.failureMode: Generated datapack JSON can overstate observed vanilla examples as a complete schema or reference nonexistent vanilla paths.

recipes.title: Generate or review resource pack assets, models, or item definitions
when: the request writes resource pack pack.mcmeta, models, item definitions, textures, sounds, or language files
the request migrates resource pack paths or model JSON between versions

steps.action: Resolve target Java version, resourcepack coverage, fact surfaces, and output requirements.
evidence: Resolved Java version and resourcepack coverage warnings
Resourcepack output requirements for final answer checks
steps.stopIfMissing: Ask for a target version or state the latest bundled-version assumption before generating resource pack files.

steps.action: Verify resource pack format before generating or changing pack.mcmeta.
evidence: Version detail packFormats.resource for the target version
Version support entry for resourcepack
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not infer resource pack format from neighboring versions.

steps.action: Search vanilla asset paths and observed model or item definition summaries for referenced paths and fields.
evidence: Target-version vanilla asset path search result
Observed model or item definition field path match when claiming a field shape
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not invent vanilla asset paths or present observed model summaries as complete rendering behavior.

recipes.failureMode: Generated resource packs can reference nonexistent assets or overstate observed model data as a full client schema.

recipes.title: Generate or review a Paper event listener
when: the request asks for listener code
the request describes behavior that should happen on a Bukkit or Paper event
the request asks which event class to use

steps.action: Resolve target version, Paper support, API reference, guardrails, claim policies, and output requirements.
evidence: Paper support metadata for the target version
Paper API reference and Javadocs URL for supported versions
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not emit Paper dependency coordinates for an unsupported target version.

steps.action: Use event search for candidates, then verify event type names against the Paper API surface.
evidence: Event search result for the described behavior
Paper Javadocs type match for the selected event class
steps.stopIfMissing: Treat search results as candidates only; do not generate listener code for an event class not verified by the API surface.

steps.action: Search every referenced event, player, entity, server, scheduler, or component type/member name.
evidence: Paper Javadocs type search result for each referenced type
Paper Javadocs member search result for each referenced member label
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not invent API names; name presence does not prove behavior, nullability, or thread safety.

recipes.failureMode: Generated listener code can target unsupported Paper versions, unverified event classes, or invented API members.

recipes.title: Generate or review Paper API, command, scheduler, or Folia-sensitive code
when: the request writes Paper plugin code that calls Bukkit, Paper, Adventure, scheduler, world, entity, or chunk APIs
the request asks whether an API type or member exists
the request touches async work, scheduling, Folia, worlds, entities, or chunks

steps.action: Resolve the target version's Paper support, dependency coordinates, Javadocs URL, and scheduler/Folia documentation links.
evidence: Paper support entry for the target version
Paper API dependency and documentation links for supported versions
steps.stopIfMissing: State the Paper support gap instead of generating coordinates for unsupported latest Java versions.

steps.action: Search types and members in the target Paper API surface and fetch the surface if it is downloadable but missing locally.
evidence: Paper Javadocs type search result for each referenced type
Paper Javadocs member search result for each referenced member label
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not emit unverified type or member names.

steps.action: Use claim policies and Paper reference links to keep behavior, scheduler, and Folia claims bounded.
evidence: Paper type/member claim policy
Folia or thread-safety claim policy when scheduling, worlds, entities, chunks, or async work are involved
Paper scheduler and Folia documentation links when relevant
steps.stopIfMissing: Do not infer runtime behavior, nullability, thread safety, or Folia safety from Javadocs name presence alone.

recipes.failureMode: Generated plugin code can compile against invented API names or hide behavior and threading assumptions.
